[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided suggestions for a simple vinaigrette to accompany the quinoa salad: Classic Vinaigrette, Lemon-Herb Vinaigrette, Balsamic Vinaigrette.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Assistant provided a recipe for Classic Vinaigrette: 2 tablespoons olive oil, 2 tablespoons apple cider vinegar or white wine vinegar, 1 teaspoon Dijon mustard, salt and pepper to taste.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant suggested storing vinaigrette in an airtight container in the fridge for up to 5 days.
